primitive: REG_MULTINOMIAL penalty l2 / l1 / elasticnet: glmnet's symmetric multinomial, ungrouped, unstandardised, intercepts unpenalised
r_function: glmnet(x, y, family = "multinomial", type.multinomial = "ungrouped", weights, alpha = l1_ratio, lambda = alpha * sum(pf) / nvars, penalty.factor = pf, standardize = FALSE, control = list(thresh = 1e-20, maxit = 1e7))
note: Pulse alpha = glmnet lambda; Pulse l1_ratio = glmnet alpha (l2 0, l1 1); pf 0 on `unpenalized`, lambda * sum(pf) / nvars undoes glmnet's rescaling. rows are [x1, x2, x3, y, w], y 0-based over levels; N* = sum(w). coefficients: category-major over levels, terms (intercept), x1, x2, x3; Newton-polished on the active set to the stated objective, unpenalised terms centred; KKT self-checked at relative 1e-10. deviance: the unpenalised -2 loglik at the penalised estimate; null_deviance at the category shares. score_probabilities / score_link: the grid rows' category probabilities and linear predictors x'b_k, row-major.
